subject: Staggered shift coverage and volunteer cadence for SRE on-site interview (Chiu)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02 09:12 -0700
Subject: Coverage ask — SRE on-site (Alex Chiu) next Wed (4/7)

Hi team,

Schedule hiccup — candidate Alex Chiu is on-site next Wednesday (4/7) for the SRE final loop. We lost two panelists due to travel and need to reassign two of the technical deep-dive slots (11:00 and 14:00 PT). Can Monica or Marissa help coordinate short-notice coverage? Prefer folks who can do 90-minute dive and a 30-minute debrief.

Constraints:
- Candidate arrives 10:30 PT; prefer spread across day to reduce candidate fatigue.
- Keep at least one interviewer senior (IC4+) for architecture review.
- We need notes captured in the debrief doc and a short feedback window (2h post final).

Thanks — Jonas

Jonas Weber
Hiring Manager, SRE
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02 09:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage ask — SRE on-site (Alex Chiu) next Wed (4/7)

Thanks for the heads up, Jonas.

I can take the 11:00 deep-dive if someone can cover the 14:00 slot (short 90->60 adjust ok). I'm going to stand up a volunteer cadence and pull a small pool for next-week swaps to avoid heroic last-minute asks — attaching a quick cadence grid.

Plan proposal (high level):
- Volunteer pool: 6 engineers (mix of senior and IC3+) who agree to be pinged for swaps; rotate day-of backups.
- Buffer slot: keep 13:00 PT as a fallback for overflow/reschedules.
- Debrief owner: whoever covers the 14:00 to run the debrief doc and submit feedback within 2 hours.

Marissa / Lauren / Grace — can you confirm availability for 14:00 or nominate someone from your teams? If you can give me names by 12:00 PT today I’ll lock the schedule and send calendar updates to the candidate and talentops.

Attaching: cadence_grid.xlsx (draft) and candidate-pack-Chiu.pdf (resume + score rubric).

—Monica
Monica Patel
Recruiting Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02 10:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage ask — SRE on-site (Alex Chiu) next Wed (4/7)

Got it. I can move Emily Zhao (IC4, platform infra) into the 14:00 slot — she said yes to a swap if we cover one of her internals next week. Emily is strong on systems design and ops runbooks; she'll be good for the architecture piece if Jonas still wants a senior in that loop.

I’ll let Emily own the debrief doc after the loop.

Marissa
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02 14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage ask — SRE on-site (Alex Chiu) next Wed (4/7)

Quick follow — I can cover a 30-minute debrief immediately after the final if needed (15:30 PT). I can’t do the 14:00 slot because I have a calibration meeting, but I can be the debrief owner if Emily prefers a different time.

Also adding: can we make the volunteer cadence opt-in per quarter? Want to avoid over-subscribing the same people week-over-week. If Monica wants, I can draft a short volunteer policy blurb.

Thanks,
Lauren
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chiu <alex.chiu+applicant@gmail.com>, talentops@recruitingco.com
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03 11:47 -0700
Subject: Finalized schedule — SRE on-site (Alex Chiu) 4/7 + logistics

Alex / TalentOps — thanks for the flexibility. Below is the finalized cadence for 4/7:

10:30 — Candidate arrival / check-in
11:00–12:30 — Technical deep-dive 1 (Monica facilitating, Jon's team context) — Monica Patel
12:30–13:15 — Lunch break / buffer
13:15–14:45 — Systems architecture deep-dive — Emily Zhao (covering per Marissa)
14:45–15:15 — Short break / overlap buffer
15:15–15:45 — Debrief & feedback collection — Lauren Bishop (debrief owner)

Notes:
- Please use the candidate debrief doc link in the calendar invite to capture rubrics and decision notes.
- We’ll aim for 2-hour feedback window after the final loop for decision sync.
- Emily will take the technical lead; Lauren will consolidate debrief.

Attachments: candidate-pack-Chiu.pdf (resume + rubric), slot_availability.ics (calendar updates), cadence_grid.xlsx (volunteer pool draft).

Alex — please confirm you have the updated invite and that the 11:00 / 13:15 slots work for you.

Best,
Monica
From: Alex Chiu <alex.chiu+applicant@gmail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, talentops@recruitingco.com
Date: 2027-04-05 16:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalized schedule — SRE on-site (Alex Chiu) 4/7 + logistics

Hi Monica / team,

Thanks for the update — confirmed. The 11:00 and 13:15 slots are good, and I received the updated calendar invite and materials. Appreciate the clarity on the debrief timing. Looking forward to meeting everyone.

Best,
Alex Chiu
Candidate
